title: In This Town, Every Fight Is A Dance Battle

publish.title: Dance Battle Decides EVERYTHING In This Town #shorts
publish.description: In this town, every argument is settled with a dance battle, and the worst dancer has to face the meanest outlaw in the West. What would your signature move be?
publish.caption: In this town, every fight is a dance battle 🤠🐔

scenes.line: In this town, every fight is settled with a *dance* battle.
scenes.title: IN THIS TOWN...

scenes.line: No yelling. No pushing. Just *moves*.
Somebody took your seat? *Dance* battle.
Last cookie in the jar? Dance *battle*.
Even the sheriff arrests people with the *moonwalk*.
I was the worst dancer in the whole *county*.
My only move was called the confused *chicken*.
My little brother Max thought it was *amazing*.
So I never argued with *anybody*. Ever.
Then Black Bart rode into *town*.
The best dancer in the West. And the *meanest*.
He challenged the sheriff for the whole *town*.
The sheriff did the moonwalk. Bart did a *backflip*.
Ten to nothing. The sheriff handed over his *star*.
Bart's first rule: nobody dances but *him*.
The town went *quiet*. No music. No moves.
Max asked me to do the confused chicken. I said *no*.
Then Bart took Max's lucky *ball*. That was it.
My legs were shaking. I challenged him *anyway*.
High noon. The whole town came to *watch*.
Bart went first. Spins. Flips. The *splits*.
The crowd gave him a perfect *ten*.
My turn. My brain went completely *blank*.
So I did the only move I *had*.
The confused *chicken*.
Nobody had ever seen anything so *weird*.
Then Max started doing it *too*.
Then Zoe. Then the sheriff. Then *everybody*.
A whole town of confused *chickens*.
Bart tried to copy it. He fell on his *hat*.
Turns out, you can't beat a move made of pure *joy*.
Bart gave back the star, the ball, and the *town*.
Then he asked me to *teach* him.
Now Bart runs the dance school. Chicken class is *full*.
And the town gave me a trophy for worst best *dancer*.
I still only know one move. Turns out, one is *enough*.
